# Global Chemicals LLC

> B2B industrial and specialty chemical supplier based in Ghala, Muscat, Oman, supplying and exporting across the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain). ISO 9001:2015 certified, JSRS registered, and ICV compliant. Catalog spans water treatment, oilfield, food & beverage, laboratory, and specialty chemicals.

## About

Global Chemicals LLC supplies bulk and specialty chemicals to water treatment, oil & gas, food & beverage, manufacturing, and laboratory sectors across Oman and the wider GCC. Pricing is quote-based (price-on-application). Deliveries across the GCC typically ship within 1-7 days.

- Address: Office-3, Building Number 1737, Near Oman LNG, Ghala, Muscat, Oman (PC 111)
- Phone: +968 93754388
- Email: info@gcoman.com
- Hours: Sunday-Thursday, 08:00-18:00 (GST)
- Certifications: ISO 9001:2015, JSRS (Joint Supplier Registration System), ICV (In-Country Value)
